script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

Title: The Chroniclers of Elysium

INT. ELYSIUM LABORATORIES - NIGHT

A modern, sleek lab. Dr. JENA LEE (30s), brilliant scientist with a quirky personality, stands before a Holographic Table. Holographic images of ancient texts flicker around her. She's absorbed in her work.

JENA
(mumbling to herself)
If only I could decipher this...

Suddenly, the holographic screen flashes an image of an ancient artifact - a CHRONICLE.

JENA
(whispering in awe)
The Chronicles of Elysium...

INT. ELYSIUM LABORATORIES - LATER

Jena sits at her desk, pouring over the ancient texts. Her COLLEAGUE, Dr. ALAN WILLIAMS (40s), enters. He's a no-nonsense pragmatist.

ALAN
What's got you so engrossed, Jena?

JENA
(excited)
Alan, I've found something incredible! The Chronicles of Elysium! They're the key to unlocking advanced technology!

ALAN
(skeptical)
Another ancient relic? That's a long shot, Jena.

JENA
(determined)
But this isn't just any relic, Alan. It's said to be a symbol of friendship between worlds.

INT. ELYSIUM LABORATORIES - DAY

The duo embarks on a quest to decipher the Chronicles. They work tirelessly, often late into the night.

INT. ELYSIUM LABORATORIES - WEEKS LATER

They've made progress, but the deciphering is far from complete. Alan becomes increasingly frustrated.

ALAN
Jena, we've been at this for weeks! We're not any closer to understanding this.

JENA
(determined)
We'll figure it out, Alan. We have to.

INT. ELYSIUM LABORATORIES - NIGHT

Jena, exhausted, falls asleep at her desk. In her dream, she is transported to a beautiful, lush world - ELYSIUM. She meets her counterpart, SYRINA, a brilliant scientist from this world.

SYRINA
(smiling)
Welcome, Jena, to Elysium. I've been waiting for you.

JENA
(amazed)
How did you know I was coming?

SYRINA
(laughs)
The Chronicles of Elysium, of course. They're a bond between us.

INT. ELYSIUM LABORATORIES - DAY

Jena wakes up, startled. She shares her dream with Alan. He's skeptical but intrigued.

ALAN
(thoughtful)
Maybe there's more to these Chronicles than we thought.

INT. ELYSIUM LABORATORIES - WEEKS LATER

Jena and Alan, with renewed energy, work tirelessly to decipher the Chronicles. Their friendship deepens as they unravel the secrets.

INT. ELYSIUM LABORATORIES - NIGHT

They finally crack the code. The lab lights up with a soft glow.

JENA
(elated)
We did it, Alan!

ALAN
(smiling)
We couldn't have done it without you, Jena.

INT. ELYSIUM - NIGHT

Jena and Alan, now friends, walk hand in hand in the beautiful world of Elysium. They've unlocked a technology that could change the world, but more importantly, they've formed a bond stronger than any relic.

FADE OUT.

End screenplay.
